company.name: RealDeed
company.shortDescription: MENA’s Advanced Real Estate Tokenization Platform
company.description: RealDeed is MENA’s advanced real estate tokenization platform empowering property owners, developers, and asset managers to transform real-world assets into digital tokens on the blockchain. The platform enables secure, compliant, and fractional ownership of real estate across Dubai, India, and the UK — bridging traditional property markets with Web3 technology to enhance liquidity, transparency, and accessibility in real estate investment.
